about: Country cards for lives born in China. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== China (CN) ===================== Gaokao: 13.35 million registered in 2025 (Ministry of Education via Xinhua and The Paper). Extra-class costs are an ESTIMATE; a poorer family borrows and you help repay it (famCost).

opts.do: addSkill('school', 6 * learnLuck('gk'), M('trk.school')); happy -= 5; health -= 2; famCost('cn_gaokao', .25)

en..x: Next June you sit the gaokao, the university entrance exam, with more than 13 million others (13.35 million in 2025). Your score decides which universities you can enter.
en..cram: Extra classes every evening and weekend
en..cram.s: Your family pays about {a}. Exhausting: Happiness −5.
en..cram.h: Skill +6 (more or less, depending on the exam days). Health −2.
en..no: Your family can’t afford extra classes.
en..steady: Study hard but keep your sleep

zh..x: 明年六月你要参加高考，和一千三百多万人一起考（2025年报名1335万人）。分数决定你能上哪些大学。
zh..cram.s: 家里付约{a}。精疲力尽：幸福感 −5。
zh..cram.h: 技能 +6（看考试那几天的发挥，或多或少）。健康 −2。

zht..x: 明年六月你要參加高考，和一千三百多萬人一起考（2025年報名1335萬人）。分數決定你能上哪些大學。
zht..cram.s: 家裡付約{a}。精疲力盡：幸福感 −5。
zht..cram.h: 技能 +6（看考試那幾天的發揮，或多或少）。健康 −2。

events.src: Hukou and the big cities: since 2019 cities with 1–3 million urban residents were told to lift hukou limits (NDRC, Key Tasks for New Urbanisation 2019); first-tier cities still tie home buying and school places to local hukou or years of social insurance. Pay and cost multiples are ESTIMATES from the gap in typical wages and rents.

en..t: A job in a big city
en..x: A company in a first-tier city (Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou or Shenzhen) offers you {a} a year. Without a local hukou, buying a home there or getting a public school place for your children can take years of paying into the city’s social insurance. Many second-tier cities now grant hukou easily.
en..go.s: Pay {a} a year. Rent and daily costs about 45% higher, and homes cost much more. Happiness −1.
en..mid.s: Pay {a} a year. Costs about 12% higher, and hukou is easy to get. Happiness −1.
en..stay.s: Close to family, and your costs stay low.

zh..x: 一线城市（北京、上海、广州或深圳）的一家公司给你年薪{a}。没有当地户口，买房或让孩子上公办学校，往往要先在当地交好几年社保。很多二线城市现在落户很容易。
zh..go.s: 年薪{a}。房租和日常开销约高45%，房价也高得多。幸福感 −1。
zh..mid.s: 年薪{a}。开销约高12%，落户容易。幸福感 −1。

zht..x: 一線城市（北京、上海、廣州或深圳）的一家公司給你年薪{a}。沒有當地戶口，買房或讓孩子上公辦學校，往往要先在當地交好幾年社會保險。很多二線城市現在落戶很容易。
zht..go.s: 年薪{a}。房租和日常開銷約高45%，房價也高得多。幸福感 −1。
zht..mid.s: 年薪{a}。開銷約高12%，落戶容易。幸福感 −1。

events.src: 996: China's labour law limits work to 44 hours a week on average, with at most 36 hours of overtime a month; in Aug 2021 the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security said 996 schedules break the law (Sixth Tone; Quartz). Pay, promotion and health effects are game rules.

en..x: Your team works “996”: 9 a.m. to 9 p.m., six days a week. The labour law allows 44 hours a week on average and at most 36 hours of overtime a month, and in 2021 the Supreme People’s Court and the labour ministry said 996 schedules break it, but some firms still expect it.
en..go.s: Overtime and bonuses add about 10% to your pay for five years. Happiness −3.
en..go.h: Faster promotions. Health −1.5 a year for five years.
en..line: Do your hours well and go home
en..move: Move to a firm with normal hours

zh..x: 你的团队实行“996”：早九点到晚九点，一周六天。劳动法规定平均每周不超过44小时、每月加班不超过36小时；2021年最高人民法院和人社部明确996违法，但仍有公司这样要求。
zh..go.s: 加班费和奖金让收入提高约10%，持续五年。幸福感 −3。
zh..go.h: 升职更快。五年内每年健康 −1.5。

zht..x: 你的團隊實行「996」：早九點到晚九點，一週六天。勞動法規定平均每週不超過44小時、每月加班不超過36小時；2021年最高人民法院和人社部明確996違法，但仍有公司這樣要求。
zht..go.s: 加班費和獎金讓收入提高約10%，持續五年。幸福感 −3。
zht..go.h: 升職更快。五年內每年健康 −1.5。

events.src: Buying a flat: housing provident fund loans for a first home cost 2.6% from 8 May 2025 (PBoC, via The Paper and Beijing News); CPI inflation near 0.5% leaves about 2% real. New-home prices in 70 cities fell for 32 months in a row to Feb 2026 (NBS via Trading Economics). Parents' help ("six wallets") by family background and the price path ahead are ESTIMATES.

let.g: byFam({ poor: 0, working: .08, middle: .15, rich: .3 }) * P

opts.ok: g <= 0 ? M('.no') : liq + g >= .32 * P || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.32 * P - g), h: MN(liq) })
opts.do: cash += g; const t = T('cn_gift', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.cn_gift'), v: g, note: M('note.got', { a: MN(g) }) }); buyAt(P, { dp: .3, fee: .02, r: .02, n: 30 }); drift()

opts.ok: liq >= .18 * P || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.18 * P), h: MN(liq) })
opts.do: buyAt(.55 * P, { dp: .3, fee: .02, r: .02, n: 30, lk: 'trk.flat' }); drift()

later.hmove: hm *= x.m; if (house) house.value *= x.m; log(M(x.m < 1 ? 'log.hmDown' : 'log.hmUp', { p: Math.round(Math.abs(x.m - 1) * 100) }), x.m < 1 ? 'bad' : 'good')

en..x: You’d like to buy a flat ({p}). Parents on both sides often help with the down payment. A housing provident fund loan costs 2.6% a year for a first home (since May 2025), less than a bank mortgage. New-home prices fell for 32 months in a row up to early 2026.
en..family.s: Your family gives {g}; you add {d} for the 30% down payment and fees, and borrow {l}.
en..no: Your family can’t help with a down payment.
en..small: A small flat further out, on your own

zh..x: 你想买一套房（{p}）。双方父母常会帮忙付首付。首套房的住房公积金贷款利率为2.6%（2025年5月起），比商业贷款低。新房价格到2026年初已连续下跌32个月。
zh..family.s: 家里给{g}；你再出{d}凑够三成首付和税费，贷款{l}。
zh..small: 自己在远一点的地方买套小的

zht..x: 你想買一套房（{p}）。雙方父母常會幫忙付頭期款。首套房的住房公積金貸款利率為2.6%（2025年5月起），比商業貸款低。新房價格到2026年初已連續下跌32個月。
zht..family.s: 家裡給{g}；你再出{d}湊夠三成頭期款和稅費，貸款{l}。
zht..small: 自己在遠一點的地方買套小的

events.src: The civil service exam: about 3.7 million people sat the national exam in late 2025 for 38,100 posts; the age limit rose from 35 to 38 (China Daily HK, 1 Dec 2025; Xinhua via The Tribune; Caixin, 15 Oct 2025). The chance to pass is a game rule.

en..x: About 3.7 million people sat the national civil service exam in late 2025 for 38,100 posts, after the age limit was raised from 35 to 38. Provincial exams add many more posts. A government job is steady and comes with a pension.

zh..x: 2025年底的国考约有370万人参加，招录38,100人；年龄上限从35岁放宽到38岁。各省的省考还有更多岗位。公务员工作稳定，还有养老金。

zht..x: 2025年底的國考約有370萬人參加，招錄38,100人；年齡上限從35歲放寬到38歲。各省的省考還有更多崗位。公務員工作穩定，還有退休金。

events.src: Personal pension: up to ¥12,000 a year deductible from taxable income, gains untaxed, 3% tax when you draw it; nationwide from 2024 (Ministry of Finance and State Taxation Administration notice No. 21 of 2024, via cs.com.cn). ¥12,000 ÷ the game's typical wage (¥41,700) ≈ 0.29. The net tax saving (about 7% of what you put in) is an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: yearly('cnpen', { amt: .29 * B, until: 60, bonus: .07 }, { lock: 60 }, 'trk.cnpen')
yearly('cnpen', { amt: .14 * B, until: 60, bonus: .07 }, { lock: 60 }, 'trk.cnpen')

en..x: In a personal pension account, up to ¥12,000 a year comes off your taxable income. The money is locked until you retire and taxed at only 3% when you take it out.
en..max: Put in the full ¥12,000 a year
en..max.s: About {a} a year until 60, invested in funds. Your tax bill falls by about {b} a year.
en..half.s: About {a} a year until 60. Your tax bill falls by about {b} a year.
en..no.s: Keep your money free to use.

zh..x: 个人养老金账户每年最多12,000元可以税前扣除。钱要锁到退休，领取时只按3%缴税。
zh..max.s: 每年约{a}，存到60岁，买基金。每年少缴约{b}的税。
zh..half.s: 每年约{a}，存到60岁。每年少缴约{b}的税。

zht..x: 個人養老金帳戶每年最多12,000元可以稅前扣除。錢要鎖到退休，領取時只按3%繳稅。
zht..max.s: 每年約{a}，存到60歲，買基金。每年少繳約{b}的稅。
zht..half.s: 每年約{a}，存到60歲。每年少繳約{b}的稅。

events.src: Residents' medical insurance: ¥400 a person for 2025 in most places, plus ¥670 of government money (Sichuan and national notices, via The Paper and the Sichuan news site): ¥400 ÷ ¥41,700 ≈ 0.01. The share of bills it pays (about half overall) is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Without an employer’s insurance, you can join the urban and rural residents’ medical insurance. In most places it cost ¥400 a person for 2025, with ¥670 more paid by the government, and it pays back part of your hospital bills.
en..join.h: It pays about half of your medical bills.
en..skip.s: You keep the premium but pay every bill in full.

zh..x: 没有单位的医保，你可以参加城乡居民医保。2025年大多数地方个人每年交400元，财政再补670元，住院费用能报销一部分。
zh..join.h: 能报销大约一半的医药费。
zh..skip.s: 省下保费，但医药费全部自付。

zht..x: 沒有單位的醫保，你可以參加城鄉居民醫保。2025年大多數地方個人每年交400元，財政再補670元，住院費用能報銷一部分。
zht..join.h: 能報銷大約一半的醫藥費。
zht..skip.s: 省下保費，但醫藥費全部自付。

events.src: Retirement age: from 1 Jan 2025 China raises retirement ages over 15 years (men 60 → 63; women 50 → 55 and 55 → 58), allows flexible claiming up to three years early or late, and raises minimum contribution years from 15 to 20 from 2030 (NPC Standing Committee decision, Sep 2024). How much an earlier or later claim changes the pension is an ESTIMATE (about 5% a year).

en..x: Since January 2025 China has been raising its retirement ages over 15 years (men from 60 to 63; women from 50 or 55 to 55 or 58), and from 2030 a pension needs 20 years of contributions instead of 15. You can claim your basic pension up to three years before or after your statutory age.

zh..x: 从2025年1月起，中国用15年逐步延迟退休年龄（男性从60岁到63岁；女性从50或55岁到55或58岁），从2030年起领养老金的最低缴费年限从15年提高到20年。你可以在法定退休年龄前后三年内弹性领取基本养老金。

zht..x: 從2025年1月起，中國用15年逐步延遲退休年齡（男性從60歲到63歲；女性從50或55歲到55或58歲），從2030年起領退休金的最低繳費年限從15年提高到20年。你可以在法定退休年齡前後三年內彈性領取基本養老金。

events.src: Hukou: big cities such as Shanghai and Shenzhen grant local household registration through points for education, tax and years of social insurance, while smaller cities have eased the rules (State Council, five-year plan on people-centred urbanisation, July 2024). A local hukou gives children full access to public schools and the local gaokao. Rural hukou holders keep rights to their village land, which some rent out. Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: After years in the city you could earn a local hukou through the points system. Your hometown hukou comes with a share of village farmland.
en..city: Move your hukou to the city
en..city.s: About {a} in extra social insurance years and paperwork.
en..city.h: Happiness +1; your children can go to local schools and sit the local gaokao, which lowers their study costs.
en..keep: Keep your hometown hukou and the land
en..keep.s: Rent the land to a neighbour for about {a} a year.
en..keep.h: Your children may face higher costs to study in the city.

zh..x: 在城里住了几年，你可以通过积分落户。老家的户口则带着一份村里的承包地。
zh..city.s: 补缴社保和办手续大约{a}。
zh..city.h: 幸福感 +1；孩子能读本地学校、参加本地高考，教育开销会少一些。
zh..keep.s: 把地租给邻居，每年大约{a}。
zh..keep.h: 孩子在城里读书可能要花更多钱。

zht..x: 在城裡住了幾年，你可以透過積分落戶。老家的戶口則帶著一份村裡的承包地。
zht..city.s: 補繳社保和辦手續大約{a}。
zht..city.h: 幸福感 +1；孩子能讀本地學校、參加本地高考，教育開銷會少一些。
zht..keep.s: 把地租給鄰居，每年大約{a}。
zht..keep.h: 孩子在城裡讀書可能要花更多錢。

events.src: Bride price (彩礼): paid by the groom’s family, often tens of thousands of yuan and far more in some provinces; the government has campaigned against “sky-high bride prices” since the 2023 No. 1 Central Document, and the Supreme People’s Court set rules on returning them in 2024. ¥100,000 ≈ 2.4 and ¥30,000 ≈ 0.7 of the game’s typical wage. Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: if (sex === 'm') spend('cn_caili', 2.4 * base, 'trk.cn_caili'); else { cash += 1.2 * base; const tq = T('cn_dowry', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.cn_dowry')}); tq.v += 1.2 * base } happy += 1
if (sex === 'm') spend('cn_caili', .7 * base, 'trk.cn_caili'); else cash += .35 * base

en..x: You and your partner are talking about marriage, and the families are discussing the bride price (caili) the groom’s side should pay.
en..big.s: About {a}. If you are the bride, your family returns half as a dowry.
en..none.s: The two of you start without debt.

zh..x: 你和伴侣在谈婚论嫁，两家人在商量男方该给多少彩礼。
zh..big.s: 大约{a}。如果你是新娘，娘家会把一半当嫁妆回送。
zh..none.s: 两个人没有负担地开始。

zht..x: 你和伴侶在談婚論嫁，兩家人在商量男方該給多少聘金。
zht..big.s: 大約{a}。如果你是新娘，娘家會把一半當嫁妝回送。
zht..none.s: 兩個人沒有負擔地開始。

events.src: Tutoring: the 2021 “double reduction” policy (双减, State Council General Office, July 2021) banned for-profit tutoring in core school subjects; many families turned to private home tutors at higher prices, while schools added free after-school services. ¥10,000 a year ≈ 0.24 of the game’s typical wage; amounts and bursary odds are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('cn_tutor', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.cn_tutor')}); rec('cn_tutor', .24 * base, 5); kidWin(.2, .7)

en..x: Tutoring schools for school subjects were closed by the “double reduction” rules. Other parents now hire private tutors at home.
en..home.h: Some tutored children win a bursary for university later.
en..school.h: A small chance of a bursary.

zh..x: “双减”之后学科类补习班关了。其他家长改请家教到家里上课。
zh..home.h: 有些补过习的孩子以后能拿大学助学金。

zht..x: 「雙減」之後學科類補習班關了。其他家長改請家教到家裡上課。
zht..home.h: 有些補過習的孩子以後能拿大學助學金。

events.src: P2P lending: around 5,000 online lending platforms operated in China in 2015–2018, promising 8–12% a year; by November 2020 regulators said none remained, after waves of collapses and frauds (CBIRC Chairman Guo Shuqing, Nov 2020). Investors recovered little. Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: A lending app promises 10% a year, guaranteed. Colleagues say they have been paid every month.
en..p2p.h: Almost all such platforms later collapsed.
en..fund.h: Rises and falls with the market.
en..bank.h: Slowly eaten by inflation, but safe.

zh..x: 有个借贷App保证年化10%。同事说每个月都按时拿到利息。
zh..p2p.h: 这类平台后来几乎全部爆雷。
zh..bank.h: 慢慢被通胀吃掉，但很安全。

zht..x: 有個借貸App保證年化10%。同事說每個月都按時拿到利息。
zht..p2p.h: 這類平台後來幾乎全部倒閉。
zht..bank.h: 慢慢被通膨吃掉，但很安全。

events.src: After P2P platforms collapsed, investors registered claims with the police; recoveries were typically a small fraction (news reports on Ezubao and other cases, 2016–2021). The 15% recovery here is an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: lots.cn_p2p.v = 0; lots.cn_p2p.tout += .15 * v; cash += .15 * v; happy -= 3

en..x: The lending app has stopped paying and its bosses have disappeared. Your {a} is frozen.
en..claim: Register your claim with the police
en..claim.h: Investors usually get back only a small part.

zh..x: 借贷App停止兑付，老板也跑了。你的{a}被冻结了。
zh..claim.h: 投资人通常只拿回一小部分。

zht..x: 借貸App停止兌付，老闆也跑了。你的{a}被凍結了。
zht..claim.h: 投資人通常只拿回一小部分。

events.src: Housing provident fund (住房公积金): employers and employees each pay 5–12% of salary; savings can be withdrawn to pay rent, or kept for a mortgage at 2.6% for first homes over 5 years (PBOC, cut from 2.85%, 8 May 2025), below commercial mortgage rates. The withdrawal size and the rate difference used here are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: cash += .2 * base; const tq = T('cn_gjj', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.cn_gjj')}); tq.v += .2 * base

en..x: Your housing provident fund has built up. You can withdraw it to pay rent, or keep it for a cheaper mortgage later.
en..keep.s: A 2.6% housing fund loan when you buy.

zh..x: 你的住房公积金攒了不少。可以提取来付房租，也可以留着以后办低利率房贷。
zh..keep.s: 买房时可以办2.6%的公积金贷款。
zh..keep.h: 以后的房贷会便宜一些。

zht..x: 你的住房公積金攢了不少。可以提領來付房租，也可以留著以後辦低利率房貸。
zht..keep.s: 買房時可以辦2.6%的公積金貸款。
zht..keep.h: 以後的房貸會便宜一些。

events.src: Migrant grandparents: about 18 million older people had moved to cities by 2015, 43% of them to look after grandchildren (National Health Commission, Report on China’s Migrant Population Development, 2016). Nursery fees in big cities run to thousands of yuan a month; ¥5,000 ≈ 0.12 of the game’s typical wage. Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your parents offer to leave their hometown and move in with you to look after the baby.
en..come.s: Free childcare, and a crowded flat.
en..come.h: Happiness −1 from the crowding; the family grows closer.
en..nursery.s: About {a} a year for three years.
en..quit.s: About 70% less pay for two years.

zh..x: 爸妈提出离开老家，搬来跟你住，帮你带孩子。
zh..come.h: 挤一点，幸福感 −1；但一家人更亲。
zh..quit: 夫妻其中一人辞职带娃

zht..x: 爸媽提出離開老家，搬來跟你住，幫你帶孩子。
zht..come.h: 擠一點，幸福感 −1；但一家人更親。
zht..quit: 夫妻其中一人辭職帶孩子

events.src: Returning home: a growing number of young workers leave tier-one cities for their home provinces, trading lower pay for far cheaper homes and family nearby (NBS Migrant Worker Monitoring Survey, 2023; media reports on “返乡”). Pay, cost and home-price ratios are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Rent, the commute and long hours are wearing you down. Your hometown is calling.
en..go.s: Pay about a third lower; living costs nearly half; homes far cheaper.
en..go.h: Happiness +3; closer to family. Good jobs are fewer.

zh..x: 房租、通勤和加班让你身心俱疲。老家在召唤你。
zh..go.s: 工资低大约三分之一；生活费几乎减半；房价便宜得多。
zh..go.h: 幸福感 +3；离家人近了。好工作比较少。

zht..x: 房租、通勤和加班讓你身心俱疲。老家在召喚你。
zht..go.s: 薪水低大約三分之一；生活費幾乎減半；房價便宜得多。
zht..go.h: 幸福感 +3；離家人近了。好工作比較少。

events.src: ESTIMATE: game rule (some who return home move back to big cities for work).

opts.do: bump.cn_fanxiang = 1; costMul = (costMul || 1) / .55; hm = hm / .35; rl(-3); happy -= 2

en..x: Your old boss in the city has a job for you at your old pay. Things at home have been quieter than you hoped.
en..back.s: City pay and city prices again.

zh..x: 城里的老上司有个职位给你，工资跟以前一样。老家的发展比你想的冷清。
zh..back.s: 城市的工资，也是城市的物价。

zht..x: 城裡的老上司有個職位給你，薪水跟以前一樣。老家的發展比你想的冷清。
zht..back.s: 城市的薪水，也是城市的物價。

events.src: Car plates: Shanghai auctions petrol-car plates monthly, at reported average winning bids around ¥90,000 in recent years (Shanghai Daily reports of the monthly auctions; ESTIMATE for today), while electric cars get a free green plate (Shanghai policy since 2014; plug-in hybrids lost it in 2023). ¥90,000 ≈ 2.2 and a new car after trade-in of ¥60,000 ≈ 1.4 of the game’s typical wage. Running-cost savings are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: spend('cn_ev', 1.4 * base, 'trk.cn_ev'); T('cn_evS', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.cn_evS')}); rec('cn_evS', -.04 * base, 10); happy += 2

en..t: A new car, a new plate
en..x: You want a new car. In your city a petrol car needs a plate from the monthly auction; an electric car gets a green plate free.
en..ev: An electric car with a green plate
en..ev.s: About {a} after trading in your old car; cheaper to run.
en..ev.h: Happiness +2, and lower running costs for years.
en..petrol: A petrol car and an auctioned plate
en..keep.h: Old cars need repairs more often.

zh..x: 你想换新车。在你的城市，油车要去每月车牌拍卖会拍牌；电动车可以免费上绿牌。
zh..ev.s: 旧车折价后大约{a}；用车成本更低。
zh..ev.h: 幸福感 +2，未来几年用车更省。

zht..x: 你想換新車。在你的城市，油車要去每月車牌拍賣會拍牌；電動車可以免費上綠牌。
zht..ev.s: 舊車折價後大約{a}；用車成本更低。
zht..ev.h: 幸福感 +2，未來幾年用車更省。

events.src: Huiminbao (惠民保): city-backed supplementary medical insurance sold alongside basic medical insurance, usually for about ¥50–150 a year, covering large bills above a deductible (NHSA and city programmes, 2023–2025). The premium (¥100 ≈ 0.0025 of the game’s typical wage) and the 15% cut in big bills are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('cn_huimin', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.cn_huimin')}); rec('cn_huimin', .0025 * base, 40); medCut = (medCut || 1) * .85

en..x: Your city sells a supplementary health plan for about ¥100 a year that pays part of very large bills.
en..buy.h: Pays part of big bills above a deductible.

zh..x: 你的城市在卖一种补充医疗保险，一年大约一百元，能赔一部分大额医疗费。
zh..buy.h: 超过起付线的大额费用能赔一部分。

zht..x: 你的城市在賣一種補充醫療保險，一年大約一百元，能賠一部分大額醫療費。
zht..buy.h: 超過起付線的大額費用能賠一部分。

events.src: Off-plan flats (期房) sell below completed ones, but in 2022 buyers in more than 300 stalled projects stopped paying their mortgages (Reuters, July 2022), and many unfinished projects took years to complete under the “guaranteed delivery” campaign (保交楼, 2022–2025). The 10% discount and stall odds are an ESTIMATE.

opts.ok: liq >= .23 * .9 * P || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.23 * .9 * P), h: MN(liq) })
opts.do: buyAt(.9 * P, { val: P, dp: .2, fee: .03, r: .03, n: 30, lk: 'trk.cn_qifang' })

opts.ok: liq >= .23 * P || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.23 * P), h: MN(liq) })
opts.do: buyAt(P, { dp: .2, fee: .03, r: .03, n: 30, lk: 'trk.cn_xianfang' })

en..x: A developer is selling flats in a block that is still being built, 10% below finished flats nearby.
en..off.h: Some developers run out of money before finishing.

zh..x: 开发商在卖还没盖好的期房，比附近现房便宜一成。
zh..off.h: 有些开发商没盖完就资金断裂。

zht..x: 建商在賣還沒蓋好的預售屋，比附近成屋便宜一成。
zht..off.h: 有些建商沒蓋完就資金斷裂。

events.src: Stalled projects: from 2022 local governments pushed developers and banks to finish stalled homes (“保交楼”); buyers kept paying mortgages on unfinished flats, often for years (Reuters; PBOC special loans, 2022–2024). Value losses are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: The developer has run out of money and the cranes have stopped. You are paying a mortgage on a flat that isn’t finished.
en..wait.h: Happiness −4; the flat is worth much less for now.
en..group: Join the other buyers to press for completion
en..group.h: About half of such projects are finished with government help.

zh..x: 开发商资金断裂，塔吊都停了。你在为一套没盖好的房子还房贷。
zh..wait.h: 幸福感 −4；房子眼下贬值很多。
zh..group.h: 这类项目大约一半在政府介入后完工。

zht..x: 建商資金斷裂，塔吊都停了。你在為一間沒蓋好的房子繳房貸。
zht..wait.h: 幸福感 −4；房子眼下貶值很多。
zht..group.h: 這類建案大約一半在政府介入後完工。
